integrity: The displayed formula is derived from an explicit support-function maximization and spherical-coordinate averaging. Numerical checks are supplementary and are not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats intersections of two congruent Euclidean balls. It does not classify higher intrinsic volumes or general intersections of more than two balls. An equivalent formula may exist in historical quermassintegral literature not fully inspectable here.
title: Mean width of a symmetric lens in every dimension
